shared_context.goal: Fix IELTS listening and reading generation quality before scaling content generation.
critical_constraints: Do not expand to 300 generated items before quality gate passes.
Keep changes backward compatible for existing content and clients.
Use original generated exam-style practice only; do not copy official test content.
Treat prompt leaks and English whitespace collapse as hard failures.

execution_waves.reason: Establish shared output hygiene and validators before changing generation behavior.
Listening profile work and reading model/metadata compatibility are mostly independent.
Reading generation depends on the reading model and metadata contract.
Fallback and TTS stability can proceed after core content shape is known.
Quality gate must verify all generation and audio changes together.
